missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Месяц' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'идёт'. 'Последний' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'года' is a genitive of relation.

missions.phrase: Я ждал этот месяц целый год.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Месяц' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'ждал'. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Месяца' is in the genitive case after 'конца', expressing the end of the month. 'До' governs the genitive 'конца'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К месяцу' uses the dative form 'месяцу' after 'к' to express a deadline. 'Следующему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Месяцем' is in the instrumental case after 'перед' to express time before. 'Прошлым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В месяце' uses the prepositional form 'месяце' after 'в' to express when. 'Этом' agrees, and 'много праздников' adds a genitive quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Месяц' is nominative as the subject of 'был'. 'Этот' points at a specific month, and 'тёплым' is the instrumental predicate after 'был'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Месяцы' is the nominative plural of 'месяц', acting as the subject of 'прошли'. 'Долгие зимние' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Месяцев' is the genitive plural after 'несколько', expressing quantity. The phrase states how long someone stayed there.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Через месяц' uses the accusative form 'месяц' after 'через' to express time forward. 'Новый сезон' is the nominative subject.
